accepted.s: The Savaras are particularly known for which combination of cultural practices?
o: Wall paintings and buffalo sacrifice called Gour
accepted.x: The Savaras are known for wall paintings and the buffalo sacrifice known as Gour.
accepted.tq: Match a tribe with its distinctive cultural practices.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Koya tribe:
1. The Koyas speak Koya Bhasha.
2. Bhumi Panduga marks the beginning of the farming season.
3. Mamidi Panduga is associated with the Koya tribe.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Koyas speak Koya Bhasha, celebrate Bhumi Panduga at the start of farming, and observe Mamidi Panduga.
accepted.tq: Combine language and festival facts, checking whether all statements belong to the same tribe.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s: With reference to tribal dances and festivals, which one of the following is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The horned-headgear dance, Adavidunna Kommu Nrutyam, is associated with the Koya tribe. Kuravanji belongs to Yerukula, Gussadi to Gond and Teej to Lambada.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure tribe–dance pair and eliminate swapped cultural associations.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s: The Sammakka–Saralamma Jatara is held at Medaram and is generally conducted once in every:
accepted.x: The Sammakka–Saralamma Jatara at Medaram is held every two years, in February, and is associated with the Koyas.
accepted.tq: Test the exact periodicity of a festival rather than its associated tribe alone.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Mamidi Panduga is listed in association with Konda Reddi, whereas the Chenchu, Yanadi and Yerukula associations are correct.
accepted.tq: Find the one cultural association that has been shifted to a neighbouring tribe.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s:
Dhimsa is traditionally danced by which of the following groups?
1. Bagata
2. Valmiki
3. Konda Dora
4. Gadaba
5. Porja
6. Savara
7. Jatapu
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Dhimsa is danced by Bagata, Valmiki, Konda Dora, Gadaba, Porja, Savara and Jatapu communities.
accepted.tq: Handle a complete list by checking whether any listed group is an outsider.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s: Dhimsa set a Guinness World Record when more than how many tribal women and girls performed it at Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, Bhogapuram?
accepted.x: More than 13,000 tribal women and girls participated in the Guinness World Record performance at the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, Bhogapuram, in July 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the exact numerical figure and distinguish it from nearby rounded distractors.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s: Dhimsa is associated with which of the following cultural occasions and geographical origin?
o: Chaitra Purab or Eetela Panduga; traced to Koraput
accepted.x: Dhimsa is danced during Chaitra Purab, also called Eetela Panduga, and is traced to Koraput.
accepted.tq: Link a cultural practice with both its occasion and place of origin.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s: Why did the Koyas replace bison horns with palm leaves in their Permakore flute?
o: To reduce the weight of the flute
To make the flute suitable for religious ceremonies
accepted.x: The Koyas replaced bison horns with palm leaves in the Permakore flute to protect the gaur. The Bison Horn Maria of Chhattisgarh are a different people.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated conservation rationale to a cultural object.
accepted.sec: Tribal languages, scripts and festivals (Savara, Koya)

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the traditional occupation of the Chenchu?
o: Basket and rope making with fortune-telling
Hunting and food gathering, with a semi-nomadic way of life
Fishing, rice cultivation and herbal medicine
Podu cultivation and service under feudal lords
accepted.x: The Chenchu traditionally practised hunting and food gathering and were semi-nomadic, being described as those who live under trees.
accepted.tq: Distinguish traditional occupations of closely associated tribal communities.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Konda Reddi — Podu and food-gathering stage
2. Koya — Podu and former soldiers of feudal lords
3. Porja and Savara — Podu and hill agriculture
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All three pairs are correctly matched. Konda Reddi, Koya, Porja and Savara are associated with the occupations stated.
accepted.tq: Verify each tribe–occupation pair rather than relying on one familiar association.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The traditional occupations of Yanadi include:
o: Fishing, rice cultivation and herbal medicine
accepted.x: Yanadis are traditionally associated with fishing, rice cultivation and herbal medicine.
accepted.tq: Directly identify the occupation cluster belonging to one tribe.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with the Yerukula?
accepted.x: Among the Yerukula, Beedari refers to basket and rope making, Kunchi to fortune-telling, and pig-rearing is also a traditional occupation.
accepted.tq: Separate similar traditional terms by matching each term with its precise meaning.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Lambada or Sugali community:
1. They were once traders and transporters.
2. Agriculture and animal husbandry are their present occupations.
3. They traditionally live in thandas.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Lambadas or Sugalis were formerly traders and transporters, and are now associated with agriculture, animal husbandry and thanda settlements.
accepted.tq: Use a time-based comparison between former and present occupations.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Yerukula — Rice cultivation and herbal medicine
accepted.x: Rice cultivation and herbal medicine are associated with Yanadi, not Yerukula. Kolam, Konda Reddi and Koya are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Detect the occupation transferred from one tribe to another.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Podu cultivation is best described as:
o: Terrace cultivation of tea and coffee
Permanent wet-rice cultivation in valley floors
Slash-and-burn shifting cultivation of jowar and maize
accepted.x: Podu is slash-and-burn shifting cultivation of jowar and maize. Fields are abandoned when the soil becomes exhausted.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact meaning of an occupational and agricultural term.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding Podu cultivation is correct?
1. It is practised in Alluri Sitarama Raju and Parvathipuram Manyam districts.
2. It may cause soil erosion and forest fires.
3. FRA pattas combined with horticulture are suggested as a remedy.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Podu is practised in ASR and Parvathipuram Manyam, can cause erosion and forest fires, and FRA pattas with horticulture are suggested as remedial measures.
accepted.tq: Combine location, environmental impact and remedial-measure statements.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Tribal farmers of Maredumilli belonging to which communities grow annatto on about 10,000 acres?
o: Konda Reddi, Koya Dora and Valmiki
accepted.x: Konda Reddi, Koya Dora and Valmiki tribal farmers of Maredumilli grow annatto on about 10,000 acres and are forced to sell it to middlemen.
accepted.tq: Combine a location, a community group and a quantitative figure in one factual identification.
accepted.sec: Tribe → traditional occupation (food gathering, podu, pastoralism)  [GROUP-II]
